name: @justindfuller/ban-code-comments
description: Detect and ban code comments across source and configuration files

scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && npm run build && npm run build:plugins
scripts.check: npm test && npm run validate:plugins && npm run validate:claude-plugins && npm run build && npm run build:plugins && git diff --exit-code -- dist plugins/ban-code-comments-hard-block/bin/launcher.js plugins/ban-code-comments-warn/bin/launcher.js plugins/ban-code-comments-claude-hard-block/bin/launcher.js plugins/ban-code-comments-claude-warn/bin/launcher.js licenses.txt
